title: Terminate diff-worker on Reset / unmount to drop stale results

done: Reset button in DiffViewer clears local state but does NOT call worker.terminate() — an in-flight diff still posts its result message after Reset, which lands in the pendingRef map if the next compare is in flight.

steps.description: Add a `cancel()` method to useDiffWorker that (a) rejects every pending promise with a DOMException('cancelled', 'AbortError'), (b) calls workerRef.current.terminate(), (c) nulls workerRef so the next runDiff spawns a fresh worker. Also terminate on unmount via the existing useEffect cleanup.
steps.done_condition: cancel() terminates + respawns the worker; pending runDiff() promises reject with AbortError

steps.description: Wire Reset in DiffViewer.handleReset to call diffWorker.cancel() before clearing state. Swallow AbortError in handleCompare's catch block so it doesn't surface as a user-visible 'compare failed' message.
steps.done_condition: clicking Reset during an in-flight diff on a large spec produces no results, no console errors, no 'compare failed' toast
